about: Restavit (doxylamine, an older antihistamine) is supplied monthly from September 2025 at night after a condition line records insomnia.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about insomnia or any other reason for doxylamine, which is supplied monthly with a night-time direction.

Phenergan (promethazine, an older antihistamine) is supplied three times, but a condition line records nausea and vomiting as the reason and the directions are not for night, so it is not for sleep and must not flag.
